fusions.name: Rotor Wash
fusions.desc: Spins up a rotor that throws 3 gusts in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each deals 9 damage and knocks its target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Finned Plummet
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Releases a finned dart from overhead that deals 20 damage and leaves the target [Stunned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Catapult Launch
fusions.desc: A launch rail throws you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Clockwork Kestrel
fusions.desc: A bonded ornithopter flies beside you. It deals 4 damage every 1.3 seconds to an enemy within 5 tiles and slows what it strikes by 15% for 2 seconds.
